en.text: This computer can't run this VexLife Windows preview.
This preview currently requires Windows x64 and enough memory for the selected local model. Nothing was changed.
VexLife is preserving this folder because it cannot safely use it as a Vex Home. Choose another location or change the folder, then check again.
Something is already using VexLife's local service coordinate, or existing runtime files cannot be proven safe to replace. This preview will not stop or overwrite an unowned process or file set.

VexLife keeps your identity, conversations and memory together in one folder on this computer: your Vex Home. Creating it does not download or start anything; you'll review the local model as a separate step.
VexLife is running inside the application. Closing the Product window returns here and keeps the Product service and local model running. Choose Quit VexLife when you want to release them.
Your Vex Home and local model are already on this computer. Starting checks those files, then starts the local model and VexLife. Nothing will be downloaded.
